name: release-desk
title: Release review desk
subtitle: Read-only evidence checks. Synthetic data in the demo.

sections.title: Release readiness
sections.sql: select project,version,owner,target_date,components,blocked_components,open_tasks,readiness from release_readiness order by target_date

sections.title: Reviews needing evidence
sections.sql: select project,release,name,effective_license,reviewer,valid_until,blockers from component_checks where cardinality(blockers)>0 order by project,release,name

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: select project,release,title,owner,due,days_overdue from task_queue where status='open' order by due
